target.name: P. falciparum PfCDPK1 Kinase
target.domain_rationale: Canonical Ca2+/calmodulin-like protein kinase catalytic domain closely aligned with Davis CAMK family kinases.
target.disease_burden: 263M annual cases and ~597,000 deaths globally (WHO), predominantly children under 5 in sub-Saharan Africa.
target.target_biology: Essential blood-stage parasite kinase regulating motor complex phosphorylation required for red blood cell invasion.
target.reference_note: ATP-competitive human kinase inhibitors (including Imatinib and multi-kinase scaffolds) have been explored for antimalarial repurposing.
